caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with elaborate carvings, set against a plain, beige background. The chair features a reddish-brown cushioned seat and ornately carved legs that end in rounded, ball-and-claw feet. The front edges of the seat and the apron display carved decorative details as well. The backrest is composed of two curved vertical supports and an intricate, interlaced splat at the center, framed by an arched and carved top rail with scrollwork at each end. The wood is shown in natural brown tones with shading to indicate depth and texture, and the cushion is rendered in a muted red color. No other objects are present in the drawing.
title: Chair
